Today, Jessica went to the bookstore. Between what times could they have gone?

Jessica woke up at 6am.
Steven saw Jessica working out at the gym from 7am to 2pm.

Emily saw Jessica taking photos near the Eiffel Tower from 3pm to 9pm.
The bookstore was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could Jessica have gone to the bookstore?

Options:
(A) 2pm to 3pm
(B) 6am to 7am
(C) 7am to 2pm
(D) 3pm to 9pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- After 2pm, Jessica was seen at the Leaning Tower of Pisa until 3pm.
- From 3pm to 9pm, Jessica was at the Eiffel Tower, which means she was not at the bookstore during this time either.
- The bookstore was closed after 9pm.

The only time period when Jessica could have gone to the bookstore is between 7am and 2pm, as these are the only times when she was not accounted for elsewhere.
